tasks.subject: Task 1: Retire the auto-update loader
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Delete the loader and every reference to it in the build and check pipeline, because approval binds to the SHA-256 of stored code and runtime code fetching can no longer work by design.

**Files:**
- Delete: `loader.js`
- Delete: `rewrite-assistant-loader.json`
- Modify: `build.mjs` (header comment; delete steps 4 and 5, and the LOADER_SRC/LOADER_BUNDLE constants)
- Modify: `selfcheck.mjs` (delete the `_LOADER` drift guard)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `loader.js` and `rewrite-assistant-loader.json` no longer exist in the repo
- [ ] `build.mjs` writes exactly one file and mentions no loader
- [ ] `selfcheck.mjs` does not read `loader.js`
- [ ] `node selfcheck.mjs && node build.mjs` both exit 0

**Verify:** `node selfcheck.mjs && node build.mjs` -> selfcheck passing lines then exactly one `build: wrote rewrite-assistant.json ... OK` line, no loader output.

**Steps:** See plan document Task 1 for literal step text.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["C:/ST/Rewrite-Assistant/loader.js", "C:/ST/Rewrite-Assistant/rewrite-assistant-loader.json", "C:/ST/Rewrite-Assistant/build.mjs", "C:/ST/Rewrite-Assistant/selfcheck.mjs"], "verifyCommand": "cd /c/ST/Rewrite-Assistant && node selfcheck.mjs && node build.mjs", "acceptanceCriteria": ["loader.js and rewrite-assistant-loader.json deleted", "build.mjs writes exactly one file and mentions no loader", "selfcheck.mjs no longer reads loader.js", "node selfcheck.mjs && node build.mjs exit 0"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Extract the stylesheet into extension.css
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Move the CSS out of the removed `marinara.addStyle` call into a standalone `extension.css` that ships in the manifest's `css` field, so the engine creates and tears down the stylesheet node.

**Files:**
- Create: `extension.css`
- Modify: `extension.js:872-1022`
- Modify: `build.mjs`
- Modify: `selfcheck.mjs`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `extension.css` contains every rule previously passed to `addStyle`, as plain CSS
- [ ] `extension.js` contains no occurrence of `addStyle`
- [ ] `build.mjs` splices `extension.css` into the bundle's `css` field and round-trip checks it
- [ ] The built bundle's `css` is byte-identical to `extension.css`
- [ ] `selfcheck.mjs` fails if `addStyle` reappears or `extension.css` goes missing/empty

**Verify:** `node selfcheck.mjs && node build.mjs && node -e "...css splice check..."` -> prints `css splice OK`

**Steps:** See plan document Task 2 for literal step text.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["C:/ST/Rewrite-Assistant/extension.css", "C:/ST/Rewrite-Assistant/extension.js", "C:/ST/Rewrite-Assistant/build.mjs", "C:/ST/Rewrite-Assistant/selfcheck.mjs"], "verifyCommand": "cd /c/ST/Rewrite-Assistant && node selfcheck.mjs && node build.mjs && node -e \"const b=require('./rewrite-assistant.json'),f=require('fs');if(b.css!==f.readFileSync('extension.css','utf8'))throw new Error('css mismatch');if(!b.css.includes('.rwa{'))throw new Error('css empty');console.log('css splice OK')\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["extension.css holds every rule from the addStyle argument as plain CSS", "extension.js contains no occurrence of addStyle", "build.mjs splices and round-trip checks extension.css", "bundle css is byte-identical to extension.css", "selfcheck fails if addStyle returns or extension.css goes missing"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Rebuild the removed host APIs as a compatibility shim
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Restore `apiFetch`, `on`, and `extensionId` on top of the Marinara 2.4 full-page host object so the existing ~3,300 lines of call sites keep working unchanged.

**Files:**
- Modify: `extension.js:1-3` (rename IIFE parameter to `host`, insert the shim)
- Modify: `selfcheck.mjs` (drift guards)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] The IIFE parameter is `host`; a local `var marinara = {...}` is built from it
- [ ] `apiFetch` prefixes `/api`, sends `x-marinara-csrf: 1` on non-GET/HEAD, and resolves to parsed JSON regardless of HTTP status
- [ ] `apiFetch` resolves `null` rather than rejecting when the body is not JSON
- [ ] `on()` registers via `addEventListener` and registers the matching `removeEventListener` with `host.onCleanup`
- [ ] `setTimeout`, `setInterval`, `onCleanup`, `log`, `storage`, `extension`, `extensionId` pass through to the host
- [ ] The whole file still parses under strict mode inside an async arrow wrapper

**Verify:** `node selfcheck.mjs` passes with the new shim drift guards, AND the strict-mode wrapper parse check prints `STRICT-MODE PARSE: OK`

**Steps:** See plan document Task 3 for the literal shim source.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["C:/ST/Rewrite-Assistant/extension.js", "C:/ST/Rewrite-Assistant/selfcheck.mjs"], "verifyCommand": "cd /c/ST/Rewrite-Assistant && node selfcheck.mjs && { printf '\"use strict\";\\n(async (marinara) => {\\n\"use strict\";\\n'; cat extension.js; printf '\\n});\\n'; } > /tmp/rwa-strictcheck.mjs && node --check /tmp/rwa-strictcheck.mjs && echo 'STRICT-MODE PARSE: OK'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["IIFE parameter is host and a local marinara shim object is built from it", "apiFetch prefixes /api, sends x-marinara-csrf on non-GET/HEAD, resolves parsed JSON regardless of HTTP status", "apiFetch resolves null instead of rejecting on a non-JSON body", "on() registers addEventListener and its removeEventListener teardown via host.onCleanup", "setTimeout/setInterval/onCleanup/log/storage/extension/extensionId pass through to the host", "extension.js parses under strict mode inside an async arrow wrapper"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Fix the storage namespace and adopt existing installs
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Pin the localStorage namespace to a fixed literal, and copy a previous install's data across on first run, because both the old and new engines generate a fresh extension id on every import.

**Files:**
- Modify: `extension.js` (the `// -- Storage --` block: `NS`, `SUFFIXES`, `adoptLegacyNamespace`)
- Modify: `extension.js` (shim from Task 3: drop the now-unused `extensionId` key)
- Modify: `selfcheck.mjs` (section 7 adoption assertions + two drift guards)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `NS` is the literal `"rwa-rewrite-assistant"`, derived from nothing
- [ ] Fresh install: adoption is a no-op returning `null`, writes nothing
- [ ] Legacy install: every present suffix copied; absent suffixes skipped, not written as `"null"`
- [ ] Already migrated: adoption returns `null` and overwrites nothing
- [ ] Adoption copies, never deletes
- [ ] `selfcheck.mjs` covers all five cases
- [ ] `grep -n "extensionId" extension.js` returns no output

**Verify:** `node selfcheck.mjs` -> prints `selfcheck: legacy-namespace adoption assertions passed`

**Steps:** See plan document Task 4 for the literal source and the five assertion blocks.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["C:/ST/Rewrite-Assistant/extension.js", "C:/ST/Rewrite-Assistant/selfcheck.mjs"], "verifyCommand": "cd /c/ST/Rewrite-Assistant && node selfcheck.mjs && ! grep -n 'extensionId' extension.js", "acceptanceCriteria": ["NS is the literal rwa-rewrite-assistant, derived from nothing", "fresh install: adoption is a no-op returning null and writes nothing", "legacy install: every present suffix copied, absent suffixes skipped", "already-migrated namespace: adoption returns null and clobbers nothing", "adoption copies and never deletes the legacy keys", "selfcheck covers all five cases", "grep extensionId extension.js returns no output"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Emit the Marinara 2.4 manifest schema
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Generate `rewrite-assistant.json` in the 2.4 Personal Extension schema so it imports with Full page access instead of silently landing in the sandboxed Worker.

**Files:**
- Modify: `build.mjs`
- Regenerate: `rewrite-assistant.json`
- Modify: `selfcheck.mjs`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] The bundle has `name`, `version`, `description`, `runtime: "client"`, `capabilities: ["full_page_access"]`, `css`, `js`
- [ ] The bundle has no `id` and no `enabled` key
- [ ] `version` is `"6.0.0"`
- [ ] `build.mjs` is the single source of the manifest metadata
- [ ] `selfcheck.mjs` fails if the emitted manifest drifts from that shape

**Verify:** `node build.mjs && node -e "...manifest shape check..."` -> prints `manifest shape OK`

**Steps:** See plan document Task 5 for the literal MANIFEST block.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["C:/ST/Rewrite-Assistant/build.mjs", "C:/ST/Rewrite-Assistant/rewrite-assistant.json", "C:/ST/Rewrite-Assistant/selfcheck.mjs"], "verifyCommand": "cd /c/ST/Rewrite-Assistant && node selfcheck.mjs && node build.mjs && node -e \"const b=require('./rewrite-assistant.json');const a=require('assert');a.equal(b.runtime,'client');a.deepEqual(b.capabilities,['full_page_access']);a.equal(b.version,'6.0.0');a.ok(!('id' in b),'id must be gone');a.ok(!('enabled' in b),'enabled must be gone');a.ok(b.js.length>1000&&b.css.length>1000);console.log('manifest shape OK')\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["bundle has name, version, description, runtime client, capabilities [full_page_access], css, js", "bundle has no id and no enabled key", "version is 6.0.0", "build.mjs is the single source of manifest metadata", "selfcheck fails if the manifest shape drifts"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Verify the rewrite round-trip in a live Marinara 2.4.0
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Confirm in a running Marinara 2.4.0 instance that selecting text in a message, rewriting it, and applying the result actually changes the stored message content, and that undo restores the original.

> **USER-ORDERED GATE - NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in `acceptanceCriteria` has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Files:**
- Modify: none (verification only)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Marinara 2.4.0 running on `http://127.0.0.1:7860` and serving the client
- [ ] `rewrite-assistant.json` imports without a schema error; Requested access shows Full page access
- [ ] No `[Personal Extension Rewrite Assistant] failed` line in the browser console after approval
- [ ] Selecting 2+ characters in a message opens the rewrite popup (or `Alt+R` does)
- [ ] BEFORE stored content captured verbatim via `GET /api/chats/<chatId>/messages`
- [ ] AFTER stored content captured, differs from BEFORE, contains the rewritten span
- [ ] The on-screen message re-renders without a page reload
- [ ] Undo restores the stored content byte-identical to the BEFORE capture
- [ ] Previous install's profiles/settings present after adoption, or defaults load cleanly on a clean machine

**Verify:** `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:7860/api/chats/<chatId>/messages` extracted for `<messageId>`, run before and after Apply -> the two outputs differ and the second contains the rewritten text.

**Steps:** Step 1 is USER ACTION REQUIRED - open both external-extension gates in C:/ST/Marinara-Engine. Then `pnpm build && pnpm start` (never `pnpm dev`), import, approve, capture BEFORE, rewrite+Apply, capture AFTER, diff, undo, re-check, verify namespace adoption, report evidence. See plan document Task 7 for literal commands.

```json:metadata
{"files": [], "verifyCommand": "curl -s \"http://127.0.0.1:7860/api/chats/<chatId>/messages\" > /tmp/rwa-after.json && node -e \"const b=require('/tmp/rwa-before.json').find(x=>x.id==='<messageId>').content,a=require('/tmp/rwa-after.json').find(x=>x.id==='<messageId>').content;console.log('AFTER:',JSON.stringify(a));if(a===b)throw new Error('STORED CONTENT UNCHANGED - the PATCH did not land');console.log('CHANGED: stored content differs')\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Marinara 2.4.0 running on http://127.0.0.1:7860 and serving the client", "rewrite-assistant.json imports without a schema error and Requested access shows Full page access", "no [Personal Extension Rewrite Assistant] failed line in the browser console after approval", "selecting 2+ chars in a message opens the rewrite popup, or Alt+R does", "BEFORE stored content captured verbatim from GET /api/chats/<chatId>/messages", "AFTER stored content captured and differs from BEFORE, containing the rewritten span", "on-screen message re-renders with the new text without a page reload", "undo restores stored content byte-identical to the BEFORE capture", "previous install's profiles/settings present after adoption, or defaults load cleanly on a clean machine"], "userGate": true, "tags": ["user-gate"], "requiresUserSpecification": false, "gateScope": "whole-plan", "failurePolicy": "stop-and-report", "requireEvidenceTokens": [["BEFORE", "rwa-before", "before-apply"], ["AFTER", "rwa-after", "after-apply"]], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
